_comment: The one contract that really is each token on each chain. A transfer is
priced from its tokenSymbol, which the SENDER chooses, so anyone can
deploy a token called USDC for a few cents. Entries here are what makes a
ONLY add a contract confirmed against a block explorer. A wrong entry
quarantines real money, which is worse than the bug this fixes. Anything
not listed is still priced by symbol and is still vulnerable.
Bridged USDC.e on Polygon is a DIFFERENT token at a different address and
carries the symbol USDC.E, so it does not collide with the native USDC
entry below. It is deliberately absent: the substrate holds no USDC.E
records, and an unverified entry could only do harm.

tokens.verified: etherscan.io — label "Circle", source code verified, exact match
polygonscan.com / blockscan.com — label "Circle: USDC Token", native USDC issued by Circle
tokens.substrate_support: 20434 records across 644 distinct addresses; no other polygon USDC contract appears at all
